I wrote `component.html` in the folder, following `DESIGN.md` and `tokens.css`. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and focus states are unchecked.

- **Layout:** the sign-in card is 400px wide, centered inside `#component` (1280px). The page has 48px of padding above and 32px at the sides. The card has 32px padding, a 1px ink border at 10% and the card radius.
- **Content:** all seven items use your exact wording. The checkbox and "Forgot Password?" share one row to keep the card compact.
- **Heading:** it uses the "step" size, because the larger heading size would overflow the card. I left out a wordmark and placeholder text, since you asked for exactly this content.
- **Form fields and buttons:** both follow the v4 specs, with 44px fields and 44px full-width pills. Sign In is the ink fill and Continue with SSO is the outlined secondary.
- **Tokens:** the file inlines only the tokens it uses, with the same values as `tokens.css`. There are no raw hex values in the component styles and no JavaScript.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so they will fall back to system fonts when the file is opened.

I first left an `onsubmit` attribute on the form, then removed it to meet the no-JavaScript rule. Edit was disabled, so I rewrote the whole file.
